parsed.why: Strongest documented protective regime: anti-discrimination since 2008, shield law, court-ordered care resumption, hate-crime enforcement. But national passport/facility/custody regime still applies; local protections can't offset national exposure. Above parent.
First state to withdraw gender-identity protections; hostile worst-tier legal posture; school bathroom rule binding all visitors. Below parent.
Worst-tier: school bathroom bans, birth-certificate dual listing outing, licence marker ban, no protections. Below parent.
Most-protective tier: shield law, X markers, anti-discrimination constitution, repealed 240.37; largest trans community. National exposure remains.
Mixed: protections exist, enforcement works (2026 court ruling), but 2025 care bans, sports ban, second-highest incident count. Near parent.
